name: Lesson 1: Using context to choose the correct verb form
descriptionHtml:
1. Question type

In this section, you will be asked to choose the correct form of the verb by using the context of the sentence or the whole passage. 

 

2. Guide to answer 

- Look at the sentence (and the rest of the passage if necessary) to decide what tense is needed. 

- Choose the correct option. Once you know which verb form is needed, skim the answer choices to find it.
